params:
  previous: ""

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
options(CWP.dataset.interactive = FALSE)
suppressMessages(pkgload::load_all(here::here(), quiet = TRUE, export_all = FALSE))
library(ggplot2)
labels <- c(params$previous_label, params$new_label)
cmp <- gta_compare_summaries(params$previous, params$new, labels = labels)
threshold <- as.numeric(params$threshold_pct)

table_out <- function(x, caption = NULL, digits = 1) {
  if (is.null(x) || !nrow(x)) { cat("\n*None.*\n\n"); return(invisible()) }
  x <- as.data.frame(x)
  if ("year" %in% names(x)) x$year <- as.character(x$year)   # no thousands separator
  # Small differences stay visible (+0.05 %, not 0)
  if ("difference_pct" %in% names(x)) x$difference_pct <- sprintf("%+.2f", x$difference_pct)
  print(knitr::kable(x, caption = caption, digits = digits,
                     format.args = list(big.mark = " ", scientific = FALSE)))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

**`r labels[1]`**: `r params$previous_info`

**`r labels[2]`**: `r params$new_info`

How to read this report:

* the summaries compared are the final datasets of each run, summed by year
  and by 5° square;
* for each dataset and each tRFMO, only the **years present in both runs** are
  compared (differences of values, strata present in one run only); the years
  present in one run only, typically the new year of a release, are listed
  apart with their totals;
* a difference is highlighted when it is larger than `r threshold` %.

# Datasets

```{r datasets, results='asis'}
table_out(cmp$datasets)
```

```{r per-dataset, results='asis'}
for (key in names(cmp$comparison)) {
  x <- cmp$comparison[[key]]
  cat("\n\n# ", key, "\n\n", sep = "")

  cat("## Years of each tRFMO\n\n")
  table_out(x$years)

  cat("## Years present in one run only\n\n")
  table_out(x$uncommon)

  cat("## Common years: totals by tRFMO\n\n")
  bs <- data.table::copy(x$by_source)
  bs[, flag := ifelse(abs(difference_pct) > threshold, "**>**", "")]
  table_out(bs)

  big <- x$annual[abs(difference_pct) > threshold][order(-abs(difference))]
  cat("## Common years: years with a difference larger than ", threshold, " % (largest 50)\n\n", sep = "")
  table_out(utils::head(big, 50))

  if (nrow(x$annual)) {
    long <- data.table::melt(x$annual, id.vars = c("source_authority", "year", "measurement_unit"),
                             measure.vars = labels, variable.name = "run", value.name = "value")
    long[, year := as.integer(year)]
    p <- ggplot(long, aes(year, value, colour = run, linetype = run)) +
      geom_line() + geom_point(size = 0.6) +
      facet_wrap(~ source_authority + measurement_unit, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = paste0(key, ": totals of the common years")) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 9) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    print(p)
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  a <- x$analysis
  cat("## Common years: detailed comparison (CWP.dataset)\n\n")
  if (is.character(a)) {
    cat("*The detailed comparison failed:* `", a, "`\n\n", sep = "")
  } else if (is.list(a)) {
    cat("### Summary of the differences\n\n")
    table_out(a$summary_of_differences)
    cat("### Strata present in one run only\n\n")
    table_out(a$compare_strata_differences_list$disapandap)
    cat("### Number of distinct values of each dimension\n\n")
    table_out(a$compare_strata_differences_list$number_init_column_final_column)
    cat("### Largest differences by dimension\n\n")
    table_out(a$compare_dimension_differences_list$Groupped_all_not_disap_or_app_to_dysplay)
    plots <- a$plot_titles_list
    if (is.list(plots) && length(plots$plots)) {
      cat("### Temporal differences\n\n")
      for (i in seq_along(plots$plots)) {
        p <- tryCatch(CWP.dataset::cwp_materialise_plot(plots$plots[[i]]), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.null(p)) { print(p); cat("\n\n") }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r markdown-summary, include=FALSE}
# Short version of this report in Markdown (summary page of the GitHub run)
if (nzchar(params$markdown_file)) {
  writeLines(c(
    sprintf("**%s**: %s  ", labels[1], params$previous_info),
    sprintf("**%s**: %s", labels[2], params$new_info), "",
    gta_comparison_markdown(cmp, threshold_pct = threshold)
  ), params$markdown_file)
}
```
